title: Fix Puzzle 3d Fill Slider Add/Remove After Stall
description: Puzzle 3d fill window utility starts filling then stops working after ~15s of waiting. Root-cause and fix: fillBuildTick fires every 120ms without coalescing into the serialized plugin WASM queue, and each tick defaults to a Full UiDirtyScope refresh — after ~15s the action queue backs up so the fill utility (and host) appear dead. Also demote fillBuildTick from Operation to View and emit a narrow window+measures ui_scope so background planning stays responsive.
summary: Made Puzzle 3d fill responsive across up-down-up gestures: ready is progress-only, reversals are preserved, reductions restart planning, and retained targets auto-materialize a newly randomized tail. Focused integration, renderer, slider, and UI typecheck checks pass.
